meta.title: Recollections of the Past
meta.description: Obsession can grant unshakeable conviction, but it also imprisons one into a trap without end.

units.rawText: Inside the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: Inside the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: Inside the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: ...Angelus, are you seeing the situation inside the Reverse Tower?
units.displayText: ...Angelus, are you seeing the situation inside the Reverse Tower?

spans.text: ...Angelus, are you seeing the situation inside the Reverse Tower?

units.rawText: After checking that it's safe several times, the pink-haired Doll who's responsible for scouting ahead sheathes her sword in the void and sends a transmission to Angelus, who's in charge of covering them.
units.displayText: After checking that it's safe several times, the pink-haired Doll who's responsible for scouting ahead sheathes her sword in the void and sends a transmission to Angelus, who's in charge of covering them.

spans.text: After checking that it's safe several times, the pink-haired Doll who's responsible for scouting ahead sheathes her sword in the void and sends a transmission to Angelus, who's in charge of covering them.

units.rawText: I wouldn't have believed it if you weren't showing me live footage...
units.displayText: I wouldn't have believed it if you weren't showing me live footage...

spans.text: I wouldn't have believed it if you weren't showing me live footage...

units.rawText: ...I can't believe how different the tower's interior has become in such a short time.
units.displayText: ...I can't believe how different the tower's interior has become in such a short time.

spans.text: ...I can't believe how different the tower's interior has become in such a short time.

units.rawText: Yes. Apart from the layout not matching the maps in our intelligence, the signs of Entropization have completely disappeared. In addition...
units.displayText: Yes. Apart from the layout not matching the maps in our intelligence, the signs of Entropization have completely disappeared. In addition...

spans.text: Yes. Apart from the layout not matching the maps in our intelligence, the signs of Entropization have completely disappeared. In addition...

units.rawText: She looks up at the ceiling overhead. The crack in the roof they had seen from outside just now has already been repaired, and the entire tower is once again shrouded in eerie darkness.
units.displayText: She looks up at the ceiling overhead. The crack in the roof they had seen from outside just now has already been repaired, and the entire tower is once again shrouded in eerie darkness.

spans.text: She looks up at the ceiling overhead. The crack in the roof they had seen from outside just now has already been repaired, and the entire tower is once again shrouded in eerie darkness.

units.rawText: Even the traces of the battle just now are gone.
units.displayText: Even the traces of the battle just now are gone.

spans.text: Even the traces of the battle just now are gone.

units.rawText: ...Is it repairing itself?
units.displayText: ...Is it repairing itself?

spans.text: ...Is it repairing itself?

units.rawText: I reach out and touch an interior wall. There is a slight ripple of operands on its surface, scattering particles of dust to smooth out the marks of battle.
units.displayText: I reach out and touch an interior wall. There is a slight ripple of operands on its surface, scattering particles of dust to smooth out the marks of battle.

spans.text: I reach out and touch an interior wall. There is a slight ripple of operands on its surface, scattering particles of dust to smooth out the marks of battle.

units.rawText: That does seem to be the case. We also observed something strange on the main battlefront too.
units.displayText: That does seem to be the case. We also observed something strange on the main battlefront too.

spans.text: That does seem to be the case. We also observed something strange on the main battlefront too.

units.rawText: When we were covering your team's infiltration, we did not come under attack at all.
units.displayText: When we were covering your team's infiltration, we did not come under attack at all.

spans.text: When we were covering your team's infiltration, we did not come under attack at all.

units.rawText: The signs of Entropization on the outside of the Reverse Tower are gradually being erased... But since the main area of fighting is outside the Reverse Tower, the Entropics are still running wild.
units.displayText: The signs of Entropization on the outside of the Reverse Tower are gradually being erased... But since the main area of fighting is outside the Reverse Tower, the Entropics are still running wild.

spans.text: The signs of Entropization on the outside of the Reverse Tower are gradually being erased... But since the main area of fighting is outside the Reverse Tower, the Entropics are still running wild.

units.rawText: The leader of the Sanctifiers frowns. She is hesitant to express her thoughts.
units.displayText: The leader of the Sanctifiers frowns. She is hesitant to express her thoughts.

spans.text: The leader of the Sanctifiers frowns. She is hesitant to express her thoughts.

units.rawText: ...It's as though time is running in reverse for the interior of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: ...It's as though time is running in reverse for the interior of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: ...It's as though time is running in reverse for the interior of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: In reverse...
units.displayText: In reverse...

spans.text: In reverse...

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect this to happen. It seems the map I provided won't be useful after all.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect this to happen. It seems the map I provided won't be useful after all.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Professor. I didn't expect this to happen. It seems the map I provided won't be useful after all.

units.rawText: That's fine. I expected something like this to happen anyway.
units.displayText: That's fine. I expected something like this to happen anyway.

spans.text: That's fine. I expected something like this to happen anyway.

units.rawText: Although, why did he go this far... I didn't think Eosphorus would expend his valuable operands on something so useless.
units.displayText: Although, why did he go this far... I didn't think Eosphorus would expend his valuable operands on something so useless.

spans.text: Although, why did he go this far... I didn't think Eosphorus would expend his valuable operands on something so useless.

units.rawText: I agree. This doesn't seem like him.
units.displayText: I agree. This doesn't seem like him.

spans.text: I agree. This doesn't seem like him.

units.rawText: In other words, there must be some reason which made him to do this...
units.displayText: In other words, there must be some reason which made him to do this...

spans.text: In other words, there must be some reason which made him to do this...

units.rawText: Persicaria, have you been able to pick up Antonina and Irida's signals after entering the tower?
units.displayText: Persicaria, have you been able to pick up Antonina and Irida's signals after entering the tower?

spans.text: Persicaria, have you been able to pick up Antonina and Irida's signals after entering the tower?

units.rawText: Their signals are weak.. I'm only getting a rough direction.
units.displayText: Their signals are weak.. I'm only getting a rough direction.

spans.text: Their signals are weak.. I'm only getting a rough direction.

units.rawText: Then let's head in that direction. Stay alert and keep your eyes on your surroundings as we move!
units.displayText: Then let's head in that direction. Stay alert and keep your eyes on your surroundings as we move!

spans.text: Then let's head in that direction. Stay alert and keep your eyes on your surroundings as we move!

units.rawText: <size=40>Roger!</size>
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: Tap— tap—
units.displayText: Tap— tap—

spans.text: Tap— tap—

units.rawText: Suddenly, the sound of rhythmic footsteps emerges from the darkness, steadily approaching our location.
units.displayText: Suddenly, the sound of rhythmic footsteps emerges from the darkness, steadily approaching our location.

spans.text: Suddenly, the sound of rhythmic footsteps emerges from the darkness, steadily approaching our location.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll immediately cuts the call short, summoning her sword into her hand. She stands in front of Eos and I, shielding us from the oncoming threat.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll immediately cuts the call short, summoning her sword into her hand. She stands in front of Eos and I, shielding us from the oncoming threat.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll immediately cuts the call short, summoning her sword into her hand. She stands in front of Eos and I, shielding us from the oncoming threat.

units.rawText: ...Did they see through our Spoof Code?
units.displayText: ...Did they see through our Spoof Code?

spans.text: ...Did they see through our Spoof Code?

units.rawText: I doubt it. The Reverse Tower's alarms didn't go off.
units.displayText: I doubt it. The Reverse Tower's alarms didn't go off.

spans.text: I doubt it. The Reverse Tower's alarms didn't go off.

units.rawText: From the sound of those footsteps... It sounds like an ordinary Lesser Sanctifier.
units.displayText: From the sound of those footsteps... It sounds like an ordinary Lesser Sanctifier.

spans.text: From the sound of those footsteps... It sounds like an ordinary Lesser Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Persicaria, we'll leave it to you.
units.displayText: Persicaria, we'll leave it to you.

spans.text: Persicaria, we'll leave it to you.

units.rawText: Persicaria meets my gaze and nods, raising her sword as she silently turns the corner.
units.displayText: Persicaria meets my gaze and nods, raising her sword as she silently turns the corner.

spans.text: Persicaria meets my gaze and nods, raising her sword as she silently turns the corner.

units.rawText: Tap— tap—
units.displayText: Tap— tap—

spans.text: Tap— tap—

units.rawText: The source of the footsteps emerges from the darkness, and the slayer lying in wait immediately steps into its blind spot, blade drawn and ready to serve steel.
units.displayText: The source of the footsteps emerges from the darkness, and the slayer lying in wait immediately steps into its blind spot, blade drawn and ready to serve steel.

spans.text: The source of the footsteps emerges from the darkness, and the slayer lying in wait immediately steps into its blind spot, blade drawn and ready to serve steel.

units.rawText: But just as the white-haired Sanctifier is about to support the attack, Persicaria's blade of solidified operands suddenly stops in mid-air.
units.displayText: But just as the white-haired Sanctifier is about to support the attack, Persicaria's blade of solidified operands suddenly stops in mid-air.

spans.text: But just as the white-haired Sanctifier is about to support the attack, Persicaria's blade of solidified operands suddenly stops in mid-air.

units.rawText: Miss... Persicaria?
units.displayText: Miss... Persicaria?

spans.text: Miss... Persicaria?

units.rawText: ...Shh.
units.displayText: ...Shh.

spans.text: ...Shh.

units.rawText: While Persicaria's partner doesn't quite understand what she's up to, upon seeing that she has ceased her attack, she follows suit and looks in the direction where their target is headed.
units.displayText: While Persicaria's partner doesn't quite understand what she's up to, upon seeing that she has ceased her attack, she follows suit and looks in the direction where their target is headed.

spans.text: While Persicaria's partner doesn't quite understand what she's up to, upon seeing that she has ceased her attack, she follows suit and looks in the direction where their target is headed.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, their prey seems completely oblivious to everything that has taken place. It walks past the three of us and heads straight down the corridor, towards its other end.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, their prey seems completely oblivious to everything that has taken place. It walks past the three of us and heads straight down the corridor, towards its other end.

spans.text: Meanwhile, their prey seems completely oblivious to everything that has taken place. It walks past the three of us and heads straight down the corridor, towards its other end.

units.rawText: It is only when it vanishes from sight that our wound-up nerves finally relax.
units.displayText: It is only when it vanishes from sight that our wound-up nerves finally relax.

spans.text: It is only when it vanishes from sight that our wound-up nerves finally relax.

units.rawText: That was close... I didn't expect there'd be a Lesser Sanctifier assigned to patrol the interior of the Tower.
units.displayText: That was close... I didn't expect there'd be a Lesser Sanctifier assigned to patrol the interior of the Tower.

spans.text: That was close... I didn't expect there'd be a Lesser Sanctifier assigned to patrol the interior of the Tower.

units.rawText: Yeah.
units.displayText: Yeah.

spans.text: Yeah.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll returns her sword to its storage in the electronic ether.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll returns her sword to its storage in the electronic ether.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll returns her sword to its storage in the electronic ether.

units.rawText: Fortunately, we didn't attack it... If we had hit it, an alarm would probably have been the least of our worries.
units.displayText: Fortunately, we didn't attack it... If we had hit it, an alarm would probably have been the least of our worries.

spans.text: Fortunately, we didn't attack it... If we had hit it, an alarm would probably have been the least of our worries.

units.rawText: That Sanctifier was definitely acting very strangely, though... Even with our Spoof Codes, it should have noticed us at such close range and performed an ID check.
units.displayText: That Sanctifier was definitely acting very strangely, though... Even with our Spoof Codes, it should have noticed us at such close range and performed an ID check.

spans.text: That Sanctifier was definitely acting very strangely, though... Even with our Spoof Codes, it should have noticed us at such close range and performed an ID check.

units.rawText: Persicaria, could you tell me why you stopped your attack? How did you know it wouldn't attack us?
units.displayText: Persicaria, could you tell me why you stopped your attack? How did you know it wouldn't attack us?

spans.text: Persicaria, could you tell me why you stopped your attack? How did you know it wouldn't attack us?

units.rawText: Could it be something extra you wrote into the Spoof Code?
units.displayText: Could it be something extra you wrote into the Spoof Code?

spans.text: Could it be something extra you wrote into the Spoof Code?

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll shakes her head to deny that notion.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll shakes her head to deny that notion.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll shakes her head to deny that notion.

units.rawText: I stopped my attack because I didn't sense any hostility from it.
units.displayText: I stopped my attack because I didn't sense any hostility from it.

spans.text: I stopped my attack because I didn't sense any hostility from it.

units.rawText: ...Alright, perhaps that's too abstract a way of describing it. To be precise, I stopped my attack because I only detected a single order from it.
units.displayText: ...Alright, perhaps that's too abstract a way of describing it. To be precise, I stopped my attack because I only detected a single order from it.

spans.text: ...Alright, perhaps that's too abstract a way of describing it. To be precise, I stopped my attack because I only detected a single order from it.

units.rawText: A single order?
units.displayText: A single order?

spans.text: A single order?

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: She reads out the order she detected, word by word.
units.displayText: She reads out the order she detected, word by word.

spans.text: She reads out the order she detected, word by word.

units.rawText: It said that it had to "hide the beverages it had made."
units.displayText: It said that it had to "hide the beverages it had made."

spans.text: It said that it had to "hide the beverages it had made."

units.rawText: Hiding beverages at a time like this? Could these "beverages" be some kind of key item?
units.displayText: Hiding beverages at a time like this? Could these "beverages" be some kind of key item?

spans.text: Hiding beverages at a time like this? Could these "beverages" be some kind of key item?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, that's all I found.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, that's all I found.

spans.text: I'm sorry, that's all I found.

units.rawText: Hide... beverages...
units.displayText: Hide... beverages...

spans.text: Hide... beverages...

units.rawText: Wait, could it be...!
units.displayText: Wait, could it be...!

spans.text: Wait, could it be...!

units.rawText: The white-haired Sanctifier seems to have realized something because she flies into the air and begins looking around the interior of the tower.
units.displayText: The white-haired Sanctifier seems to have realized something because she flies into the air and begins looking around the interior of the tower.

spans.text: The white-haired Sanctifier seems to have realized something because she flies into the air and begins looking around the interior of the tower.

units.rawText: As I thought...
units.displayText: As I thought...

spans.text: As I thought...

units.rawText: Eos!
units.displayText: Eos!

spans.text: Eos!

units.rawText: After being called by name, she lands beside me and Persicaria.
units.displayText: After being called by name, she lands beside me and Persicaria.

spans.text: After being called by name, she lands beside me and Persicaria.

units.rawText: There's no need to worry. We're in a blind spot of the Sanctifiers' detection radius.
units.displayText: There's no need to worry. We're in a blind spot of the Sanctifiers' detection radius.

spans.text: There's no need to worry. We're in a blind spot of the Sanctifiers' detection radius.

units.rawText: And the reason you could make that judgment is because...
units.displayText: And the reason you could make that judgment is because...

spans.text: And the reason you could make that judgment is because...

units.rawText: ...Yes. I've figured out the current layout inside the tower and I know what that order means.
units.displayText: ...Yes. I've figured out the current layout inside the tower and I know what that order means.

spans.text: ...Yes. I've figured out the current layout inside the tower and I know what that order means.

units.rawText: Eos' face fills with a mix of emotions.
units.displayText: Eos' face fills with a mix of emotions.

spans.text: Eos' face fills with a mix of emotions.

units.rawText: However, my hypothesis needs to be further verified. Please come with me.
units.displayText: However, my hypothesis needs to be further verified. Please come with me.

spans.text: However, my hypothesis needs to be further verified. Please come with me.

units.rawText: We follow Eos, and it isn't long before we see that Lesser Sanctifier again. It emerges from a door that has blended perfectly with the shadows of the tower and leaves again.
units.displayText: We follow Eos, and it isn't long before we see that Lesser Sanctifier again. It emerges from a door that has blended perfectly with the shadows of the tower and leaves again.

spans.text: We follow Eos, and it isn't long before we see that Lesser Sanctifier again. It emerges from a door that has blended perfectly with the shadows of the tower and leaves again.

units.rawText: I don't think I would have spotted that secret room without checking closely...
units.displayText: I don't think I would have spotted that secret room without checking closely...

spans.text: I don't think I would have spotted that secret room without checking closely...

units.rawText: To be precise, it's a secret base, though I'm not its owner.
units.displayText: To be precise, it's a secret base, though I'm not its owner.

spans.text: To be precise, it's a secret base, though I'm not its owner.

units.rawText: She doesn't explain further. Instead, she waits for that Lesser Sanctifier to go further away before pressing lightly on the secret door three times to open it.
units.displayText: She doesn't explain further. Instead, she waits for that Lesser Sanctifier to go further away before pressing lightly on the secret door three times to open it.

spans.text: She doesn't explain further. Instead, she waits for that Lesser Sanctifier to go further away before pressing lightly on the secret door three times to open it.

units.rawText: Um... Are all of these...
units.displayText: Um... Are all of these...

spans.text: Um... Are all of these...

units.rawText: I see, so this is where it was "hiding" those "beverages"...
units.displayText: I see, so this is where it was "hiding" those "beverages"...

spans.text: I see, so this is where it was "hiding" those "beverages"...

units.rawText: Just about anyone would think that upon seeing the scene before us.
units.displayText: Just about anyone would think that upon seeing the scene before us.

spans.text: Just about anyone would think that upon seeing the scene before us.

units.rawText: The tables, the floor, the chairs... Not a single piece of furniture has been spared. There are bottles of all sizes here, containing multicolored liquids that have been randomly placed throughout this cramped space.
units.displayText: The tables, the floor, the chairs... Not a single piece of furniture has been spared. There are bottles of all sizes here, containing multicolored liquids that have been randomly placed throughout this cramped space.

spans.text: The tables, the floor, the chairs... Not a single piece of furniture has been spared. There are bottles of all sizes here, containing multicolored liquids that have been randomly placed throughout this cramped space.

units.rawText: The white-haired Sanctifier picks up one of the bottles and examines it. Her face fills with a look of nostalgia.
units.displayText: The white-haired Sanctifier picks up one of the bottles and examines it. Her face fills with a look of nostalgia.

spans.text: The white-haired Sanctifier picks up one of the bottles and examines it. Her face fills with a look of nostalgia.

units.rawText: <color=orange>This was once Electra's secret base. She used it to hide from Alcyone and stash her self-made beverages.</color>
units.displayText: This was once Electra's secret base. She used it to hide from Alcyone and stash her self-made beverages.

spans.text: This was once Electra's secret base. She used it to hide from Alcyone and stash her self-made beverages.

units.rawText: Electra! Did you swap our drinks out again!?
units.displayText: Electra! Did you swap our drinks out again!?

spans.text: Electra! Did you swap our drinks out again!?

units.rawText: Swapping mine would be bad enough, but you even did it to Lord Eosphorus! He almost spat it out during a meeting...
units.displayText: Swapping mine would be bad enough, but you even did it to Lord Eosphorus! He almost spat it out during a meeting...

spans.text: Swapping mine would be bad enough, but you even did it to Lord Eosphorus! He almost spat it out during a meeting...

units.rawText: Aw, but that was my latest concoction~ It might start out a little weird, but a little more and I'm sure you'll be hooked~
units.displayText: Aw, but that was my latest concoction~ It might start out a little weird, but a little more and I'm sure you'll be hooked~

spans.text: Aw, but that was my latest concoction~ It might start out a little weird, but a little more and I'm sure you'll be hooked~

units.rawText: Obviously I had to let Lord Eosphorus try it first, right? He's not mad, is he?
units.displayText: Obviously I had to let Lord Eosphorus try it first, right? He's not mad, is he?

spans.text: Obviously I had to let Lord Eosphorus try it first, right? He's not mad, is he?

units.rawText: The nerve of you! You're lucky Lord Eosphorus didn't get mad, or you'd really be finished!
units.displayText: The nerve of you! You're lucky Lord Eosphorus didn't get mad, or you'd really be finished!

spans.text: The nerve of you! You're lucky Lord Eosphorus didn't get mad, or you'd really be finished!

units.rawText: What on earth did you even put in there to make it turn that unnatural shade of blue, anyway?!
units.displayText: What on earth did you even put in there to make it turn that unnatural shade of blue, anyway?!

spans.text: What on earth did you even put in there to make it turn that unnatural shade of blue, anyway?!

units.rawText: Oh, I get it! So you want to steal my secret recipe~
units.displayText: Oh, I get it! So you want to steal my secret recipe~

spans.text: Oh, I get it! So you want to steal my secret recipe~

units.rawText: Electra smiles evilly, then walks up to Alcyone while waggling a bottle around to show it off.
units.displayText: Electra smiles evilly, then walks up to Alcyone while waggling a bottle around to show it off.

spans.text: Electra smiles evilly, then walks up to Alcyone while waggling a bottle around to show it off.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, it's a trade secret~ But if you're willing to act cute for me, maaaaaybe I could consider it.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, it's a trade secret~ But if you're willing to act cute for me, maaaaaybe I could consider it.

spans.text: Unfortunately, it's a trade secret~ But if you're willing to act cute for me, maaaaaybe I could consider it.

units.rawText: Ally?
units.displayText: Ally?

spans.text: Ally?

units.rawText: Rage-filled operands erupt from the petite Sanctifier, and she jumps up to snatch the bottle Electra is holding.
units.displayText: Rage-filled operands erupt from the petite Sanctifier, and she jumps up to snatch the bottle Electra is holding.

spans.text: Rage-filled operands erupt from the petite Sanctifier, and she jumps up to snatch the bottle Electra is holding.

units.rawText: Irredeemable! Unforgivable!
units.displayText: Irredeemable! Unforgivable!

spans.text: Irredeemable! Unforgivable!

units.rawText: I must cleanse and purify all such harmful substances!
units.displayText: I must cleanse and purify all such harmful substances!

spans.text: I must cleanse and purify all such harmful substances!

units.rawText: Waaaaait! Alllyyy! Give it baaaack!
units.displayText: Waaaaait! Alllyyy! Give it baaaack!

spans.text: Waaaaait! Alllyyy! Give it baaaack!

units.rawText: Heck no! I'm pouring it away right now!
units.displayText: Heck no! I'm pouring it away right now!

spans.text: Heck no! I'm pouring it away right now!

units.rawText: In order to prevent Electra from catching up, Alcyone dashes off with a burst of speed and soon leaves Electra far in the dust.
units.displayText: In order to prevent Electra from catching up, Alcyone dashes off with a burst of speed and soon leaves Electra far in the dust.

spans.text: In order to prevent Electra from catching up, Alcyone dashes off with a burst of speed and soon leaves Electra far in the dust.

units.rawText: Hey! Wait! Waaaaaait!
units.displayText: Hey! Wait! Waaaaaait!

spans.text: Hey! Wait! Waaaaaait!

units.rawText: Whew.
units.displayText: Whew.

spans.text: Whew.

units.rawText: After seeing Alcyone fly off into the distance, Electra wipes the panicked look off her face and leisurely pulls two more identical bottles from her sleeve.
units.displayText: After seeing Alcyone fly off into the distance, Electra wipes the panicked look off her face and leisurely pulls two more identical bottles from her sleeve.

spans.text: After seeing Alcyone fly off into the distance, Electra wipes the panicked look off her face and leisurely pulls two more identical bottles from her sleeve.

units.rawText: Sorry, Ally, but it was your fault for not searching me. I didn't deliberately try to trick you, you know~
units.displayText: Sorry, Ally, but it was your fault for not searching me. I didn't deliberately try to trick you, you know~

spans.text: Sorry, Ally, but it was your fault for not searching me. I didn't deliberately try to trick you, you know~

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier grins evilly before landing in the shadows and touching the door hidden there.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier grins evilly before landing in the shadows and touching the door hidden there.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier grins evilly before landing in the shadows and touching the door hidden there.

units.rawText: Yup yup, this is it. Now I can continue "improving" the recipe, hehe...
units.displayText: Yup yup, this is it. Now I can continue "improving" the recipe, hehe...

spans.text: Yup yup, this is it. Now I can continue "improving" the recipe, hehe...

units.rawText: Let me see, whose beverage shall I swap next? I'd love to see Ally's face once I do it...
units.displayText: Let me see, whose beverage shall I swap next? I'd love to see Ally's face once I do it...

spans.text: Let me see, whose beverage shall I swap next? I'd love to see Ally's face once I do it...

units.rawText: You're quite a mean big sister, bullying Alcyone like that.
units.displayText: You're quite a mean big sister, bullying Alcyone like that.

spans.text: You're quite a mean big sister, bullying Alcyone like that.

units.rawText: A familiar voice responds from behind Electra, but the latter doesn't seem bothered by it at all. Instead, she continues surveying the dazzling array of homemade beverages before her.
units.displayText: A familiar voice responds from behind Electra, but the latter doesn't seem bothered by it at all. Instead, she continues surveying the dazzling array of homemade beverages before her.

spans.text: A familiar voice responds from behind Electra, but the latter doesn't seem bothered by it at all. Instead, she continues surveying the dazzling array of homemade beverages before her.

units.rawText: But that's just because Ally looks soooo cute when she puffs her cheeks up in anger. Don't you agree, Eos?
units.displayText: But that's just because Ally looks soooo cute when she puffs her cheeks up in anger. Don't you agree, Eos?

spans.text: But that's just because Ally looks soooo cute when she puffs her cheeks up in anger. Don't you agree, Eos?
